description: First anchored coordinates stay stable beside accepted moving history conditional effects
code:
class Obj(x: int, y: int, orientation: int):
    this.x = x
    this.y = y
    this.orientation = orientation
first = Obj(4, 8, 180)
if $Obj.orientation == 180:
    $Obj.tag = "l4214"
    $Obj.x = $Obj.x@first - 1
    $Obj.y = $Obj.y@first - 1
second = Obj(10, 20, 0)
second.orientation = 180
first.orientation = 180
assert([first.x, first.y, first.tag], [3, 7, "l4214"])
assert([second.x, second.y, second.tag], [9, 19, "l4214"])
assert(first.x@first, 4)
assert(second.y@0, 20)
class Moving(seed):
    this.x = seed
    this.enabled = false
if $Moving.enabled:
    $Moving.x = $Moving.x@last - 1
item = Moving(10)
item.enabled = true
assert(item.x, 9)
item.enabled = false
item.enabled = true
assert(item.x, 8)
assert(item.x@first, 10)
assert(item.x@previous, 9)
[first.x, first.y, second.x, second.y]

description: A numeric self anchor in an ordinary class rule reuses a fixed entry as external inputs change
code:
class Reading(seed):
    this.x = seed
    this.x = seed + 10
step = 1
$Reading.x = $Reading.x@1 - step
first = Reading(2)
second = Reading(20)
assert([first.x, second.x], [11, 29])
step = 2
assert([first.x, second.x], [10, 28])
assert([first.x@first, first.x@1], [2, 12])
assert([second.x@0, second.x@1], [20, 30])
[first.x, second.x]

description: A missing class self history waits for real input and observes a new lifetime after property recreation
code:
class Pending(enabled):
    this.enabled = enabled
if $Pending.enabled:
    $Pending.x = $Pending.x@first - 1
item = Pending(true)
original = item.x@first
assert(item.x, null)
item.x = 8
assert([item.x, original], [7, 8])
delete item.x
assert(original, null)
item.x = 20
assert([item.x, original], [19, 20])
assert(item.x@0, 20)
assert(item.x@2, null)
[item.x, original]

description: Caught failures restore class anchors while previous history conditionals preserve selected values and recording order
code:
class Point(seed):
    this.x = seed
step = 1
$Point.x = $Point.x@first - step
first = Point(10)
try:
    step = 4
    throw "RESTORE_CLASS_ANCHOR"
catch error:
    assert(error, "RESTORE_CLASS_ANCHOR")
assert(first.x, 9)
assert(first.x@first, 10)
assert(first.x@2, null)
step = 2
second = Point(30)
assert([first.x, second.x], [8, 28])
class Previous(seed):
    this.x = seed
    this.x = seed + 10
    this.enabled = false
if $Previous.enabled:
    $Previous.x = $Previous.x@previous - 1
item = Previous(10)
item.enabled = true
assert(item.x, 9)
assert(item.x@previous, 20)
item.enabled = false
item.enabled = true
assert(item.x, 19)
assert(item.x@first, 10)
assert(item.x@previous, 9)
assert(item.x@4, null)
[first.x, second.x]
